item.title: Police presence reported in Moraine neighborhood
item.description: MORAINE, Ohio (WDTN) -- Police responded Wednesday afternoon to a Moraine neighborhood. Our 2 NEWS crew in the 3500 block of Cozy Camp Drive reports several Moraine police cruisers at the scene. A portion of Cozy Camp Drive is currently blocked. WDTN is at the scene working to learn more information. Story is breaking...

item.description: DAYTON, Ohio (WDTN) – Ohio farmers are calling on Congress to act on a critical issue: fuel.
